tasks.title: Ask deploy bundle probe
tasks.acceptance_criteria: A pure function reports whether a set of built JS chunks carries the console's api/ask call, and scripts/probe-ask-deploy.sh applies it to BASE_URL: it exits 0 when a chunk linked from / carries the call and 1 otherwise; npm test passes.

contract.problem: Production chunks linked from / contain no api/ask string, so the Ask console never calls the model tier, and nothing in the repo detects a stale deploy. A read-only bundle check is the fastest way to tell a stale deploy from a missing call.
action_items: Create lib/ask-deploy.ts exporting chunkCarriesAskCall(text: string): boolean and bundleCarriesAskCall(chunks: string[]): boolean. The match is the literal path api/ask and nothing looser.

Add lib/ask-deploy.test.ts with cases: a chunk containing /api/ask returns true, a chunk without it returns false, an empty bundle returns false, and a chunk containing api/ask-old does not count as the console call.

Add scripts/probe-ask-deploy.mjs: fetch BASE_URL (default http://127.0.0.1:3000), collect /_next/static/chunks/*.js links from the HTML, fetch each chunk, print the count of chunks checked and the count carrying the call, exit 0 only when bundleCarriesAskCall is true.
Add scripts/probe-ask-deploy.sh as a thin wrapper that runs the .mjs with node and passes BASE_URL through. Do not change app/, components/ or the route.
Do not set env, redeploy or touch Vercel. This task only adds the probe and its unit tests.
non_goals: changing the ask route, the console or lib/ask-tier.ts
running the probe against https://otohime.dev as a verification item

tasks.title: Ask tier production probe
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Before any build work, the operator chore set-env:ask-llm-production is raised with a ready_probe on https://otohime.dev/api/ask; scripts/probe-ask-tier.sh checks GET /api/ask for 200 with enabled:true and one POST for cited model lines, and falls back to the canned answer under forced failure; the fake-Anthropic probe passes locally in both the on and off phases; npm test passes.

contract.problem: The model tier is off in production (GET and POST /api/ask return 404) and no read-only probe states what a visitor should see once the operator sets ASK_LLM and the key. The production check must exist before acceptance walks it, and the local fake must prove the same contract now.
action_items: First step, before any code: call plan_manager_ask_user with kind=operator_action, fingerprint set-env:ask-llm-production, and ready_probe {type:http, url:https://otohime.dev/api/ask, expect_status:200, body_contains:"enabled":true}. The chore is a person with the Vercel account setting ASK_LLM=1 and a server-only ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, then redeploying. If esc-381 already exists with this fingerprint, reuse it and do not raise a second one. Record the decision with plan_manager_record_decision and continue without waiting.

Add scripts/probe-ask-tier.mjs and scripts/probe-ask-tier.sh: with BASE_URL, GET /api/ask must return 200 with enabled:true; one POST with a fixed question and an allowed Origin must return model lines whose citations link to /work, /projects or /notes; the script prints counts and exits 1 on any miss. Use the same origin check the route expects.

In the probe, a forced failure (a 429 from a fixture route, or the tier-off GET) must show the canned answer and no visible error element. Reuse the page.route fake pattern from scripts/probe-ask-llm-fake.mjs.
Do not change the route, lib/ask-llm.ts or the model pin. Do not deploy or set env. The production run is not part of this task's verification; acceptance runs it after the operator chore passes.
non_goals: changing the model or the rate limits
running the production POST as verification (it spends the site-wide daily quota)
